citations.claim: NS direction in yellow, EW red, just before emergency - no all-red yet
emergency active, EW turned green with 0s all-red, violates all_red_clearance for approach 1

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (events=[]); without preemption the cycle follows NS yellow -> all-red (3s) -> EW green, so no violation.

explanation: At step 203 controller is in NS yellow (N and S yellow). At step 204 emergency for E becomes active and controller jumps directly to EW green (E and W green) with 0 seconds of all-red, violating required all_red_seconds=3. Emergency preemption logic bypasses the all-red clearance insertion that normal cycle would do.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 3 s)

vision_note: At step 203 the N and S signals are yellow while E and W are red. At step 204 E and W are already green and N/S are red, with no all-red frame between - the controller jumps straight from NS yellow to EW green.
